country and industry. five methods: domain overview, keyword-based serp research, keyword gap, position tracking, and manual google serp research. important scope note: traffic & market analysis, advertising research, and backlink gap have been excluded as requested. the remaining methods are renumbered in a clean sequence. 1. objective and research approach the objective is to identify websites that compete with our website in organic search results for the selected target country. the research should produce a verified list of relevant competitor domains, supported by keyword and visibility data. use the methods in the order below. start with domain overview to build the base list, then use keyword and serp research to discover additional domains. finally, validate relevance and remove duplicates. method 1 — domain overview: identify the main organic competitors and shortlist 50 domains. method 2 — keyword-based research: find domains ranking for our high-volume keywords. method 3 — keyword gap: find competitors ranking for relevant keywords that our website is missing or ranking weakly for. method 4 — position tracking: discover domains repeatedly appearing for our tracked target keywords. method 5 — manual google serp research: validate which websites actually appear in organic results for important searches. 2. before starting — prepare the research step 1 — confirm the website and target market write down our exact website domain (example used in the original notes: client-a-store.com). confirm the target country for this research. use the same country consistently across country-specific reports. list the main products, services, and business categories offered by our website. prepare a spreadsheet to store raw exports, keyword data, serp results, and the final competitor list. step 2 — create the research spreadsheet keep original exports and working data. do not overwrite raw research when preparing the final shortlist. tab name what to store competitor domain. open semrush and go to the “domain overview” section. enter our complete website domain in the domain search field. set the country/database selector to “worldwide” for the initial overview, as specified in the original workflow. run the report and wait for the overview dashboard to load. expected output: our website's domain overview report is displayed. step 2 — open main expected output: a country-specific competitor list. use this country consistently in the final research. step 4 — export the complete competitor data review the available pages or result rows in the competitor report. export all available pages/results rather than exporting only the first visible page. choose csv as the export format. open the downloaded csv file in excel or google sheets. keep an untouched copy of the original csv in the “domain overview export” tab or source file. expected output: a complete raw export that can be filtered without losing the original data. step 5 — apply the five competitor filters use the five filters from the original research process. apply them to the exported competitor data and review the strongest matching rows. apply “top 10 com. level” and shortlist the top-performing rows under this filter. apply “top 10 common keywords” and shortlist domains with strong keyword overlap. apply “top 10 se keywords” and shortlist domains with strong organic keyword coverage. apply “top 10 traffic” and shortlist domains with the highest traffic values. apply “top 10 costs” and shortlist domains with the highest traffic-cost values. compare the shortlisted rows across all five filters. remove duplicate domains from the working shortlist. select 50 competitors in total for the target country. save these domains in a separate tab named “final competitors”. expected output: a finalized base list of 50 main organic competitors for the selected country. filter name how to use it top 10 com. level shortlist the top rows shown by the com. level filter/metric in the export. top 10 common keywords shortlist domains sharing the most common organic keywords with our website. top 10 se keywords shortlist domains with the strongest organic keyword eeat = experience, expertise, authoritativeness, trustworthiness. e-e-a-t google na quality rater guidelines no concept chhe (direct ranking factor nathi), pan google na systems trustworthy ane helpful content ne reward kare chhe - khas karine jo site health, finance, ya shopping related hoy (ymyl - your money your life). 4 pillars practical ma experience: content lakhelu aeva vyakti pase thi jeney real experience chhe. real photos, personal examples, "ame aa try karyu" style proof. expertise: author bio with credentials, technical depth content ma, accurate information. authoritativeness: industry ma recognition - backlinks, mentions, reviews, certifications. trustworthiness: https, clear contact info, privacy policy, return/refund policy, real address/phone, ane secure payment. har page par implementation author name + bio har blog par facts mate sources cite karo updated date show karo about us ane contact pages complete ane linked reviews/testimonials real names sathe jadpi audit ek visitor tamari site par aave ane puche "saalo, aa site par bharoso kemu karu?" - je answer page par visible chhe te j eeat chhe. checklist badha content pages par author bios trust pages complete chhe (about, contact, privacy, refund) https active chhe, real contact details visible chhe facts/claims hoy tya sources cite karo

robots.txt google ne kahe chhe su crawl karvu ane su nahi. sitemap.xml google ne site na badha pages nu map aape chhe. banne technical seo nu base chhe - kharab robots.txt important pages ne crawl thi roki shake; sitemap index ni guarantee nathi aaptu, pan discovery fast kare. robots.txt na niyamo location: domain.com/robots.txt ma accessible hovu joiye. crawl block karo: admin pages, cart, checkout, internal search result pages. duplicate/filter urls ane thank-you pages mate pehla canonical/noindex vaparo — robots.txt block fakt crawl waste motu hoy tyare (ane index mathi nikli gaya pachhi). kyarey block na karo: css/js files (google render karvu joiye), main content pages. sitemap line add karo: sitemap: https://domain.com/sitemap.xml sitemap na niyamo generate karo: wordpress ma yoast/rankmath auto-banave; custom site ma generator tool. fakt 200-status, canonical urls sitemap ma hova joiye - no 404s, no redirects, no noindex pages. submit karo: google search console → sitemaps → submit. bing webmaster tools ma pan. update automatic hovu joiye new page add thay tyare. common mistakes (aa bhool na karo) "disallow: /" staging ma hoy ane live site par j reh jay - site deindex! dead urls sathe nu old sitemap sitemap submit karel pan gsc ma errors check na karela checklist robots.txt accessible ane sitemap line sathe admin/cart/search pages block karela, content pages open sitemap gsc + bing ma submit karel chhe, koi errors nathi new pages sitemap ma auto-add thay

internal links = tamari site na pages vachche na connection. google aena thi site structure samje, authority flow thay, ane users vadhare pages jove. notebook rule: har page par 3-5 internal links minimum. rules (niyamo) darek page par 3-5 contextual links: content ma naturally fit thay aeva - footer/sidebar na links count ma nathi. varietybharyu anchor text: "click here" nahi - "eggless cake delivery in surat" jevu keyword-rich text. hierarchy no flow: blog → category → product/service (money pages taraf authority flow). deep pages ne pan link: fakt homepage/popular pages ne j nahi - nava ane deep pages ne pan. anchor text ma variety: same page ne link karva different-different natural anchors use karo. structure nu example homepage → category pages → product pages (parent-child sambandh) blog "10 cake designs" mathi "chocolate truffle cake" product page ne link karo (contextual) related blogs ek bija ne link kare (topic cluster) checklist har page par 3-5 contextual internal links descriptive anchor text use karelu chhe money pages ne most internal links male chhe koi broken internal links nathi (dar mahine crawl check)

notebook (gujarati): "koi pan new page banavo to orphan page na rahe - jarur bija blog ma te te link kari do." orphan page = jene site na koi pan page mathi link nahi miltu. google ene mushkel thi find kare (fakt sitemap/backlink thi) ane internal authority nathi malti, users pan nahi pahochta - dead page. rule (niyam) darek new page → tarat minimum 2-3 internal links: related blog mathi, category page mathi, ke related service page mathi. sitemap ma hovu pan enough nathi - sitemap google ne url aape, pan internal link j authority aape. banney taraf thi link karvu best: new page mathi pan related pages ne link aapo. orphan pages shodhva screaming frog: xml sitemap sathe crawl karo (configuration → spider → crawl linked xml sitemaps) → crawl analysis pachhi sitemaps → orphan urls juo; gsc/ga4 pages list sathe pan compare karo gsc ma pages je impressions nathi aapta - suspect list simple method: page nu url site search karva try karo - kya thi link male te juvo nava page ni checklist (har vaar) page publish thaya pachhi 24 hours ma 2-3 internal links added related existing pages identify karela sitemap ma auto-add thay te confirm checklist ek pan orphan page nahi (quarterly audit) new page → e j week ma internal linking complete old orphan pages ne links added ya removed/redirected

notebook: "site content must be aeo & geo content follow". aeo = answer engine optimization (google featured snippets, people also ask, voice search). geo = generative engine optimization (chatgpt, gemini, perplexity ma tamaro content cite thay). 2026 ma ai overviews, ai mode ane ai assistants ghana searches ma pehla answer aape chhe - etle visibility mate aa jaruri chhe. aeo - answer engine mate question-format na headings: h2/h3 ma real questions ("eggless cake ketla divas fresh rahe?") pehla direct answer: question pachhi 40-60 words ma direct answer, pachhi detail faq sections har important page par (users ane ai answers mate). note: google e 7 may 2026 thi faq rich results band karya chhe - faq schema thi have google ma rich result nahi male bolchal ni language: loko jem bole tem lakho lists/steps/tables: google snippet ma aava formats prefer kare geo - ai search mate (juna sop doc na 3 factors merged) data consistency, real data: facts accurate ane site bhar same (nap, prices, claims) trusted sources par presence: llms je sources trust kare tya tamaro content/presence hovo (wikipedia, reddit, quora, industry sites, reviews) machine-readable formats: schema markup (product, article, organization, localbusiness, breadcrumb) - technical seo point 04 juvo priority na actions basic seo pehla perfect, pachhi eeat content, pachhi authority building, pachhi schema - aa order ma har page: brief answer first section → conversational language → faq section checklist top pages par

notebook point 8: "slug all keyword + main". slug = url no last part. clean, keyword-rich slug google ne page nu topic instant samjave ane users ne pan trust aape. rules (niyamo) primary keyword slug ma: /eggless-cake-delivery-surat (not /page?id=123 ke /post-45) short ane clean: 3-5 words max. stop words (and, the, nu, ke) remove karo. hyphens use karo: /eggless-cake (not /eggless_cake, /egglesscake, /eggless%20cake) lowercase j rakho: /about-us nahi - /about-us service/product slugs ma dates nahi: /best-cakes-2026 thay pan pachhi update karvu pade - evergreen rakho change karela slugs = redirects jaruri old url change karo to 301 redirect must. redirect vagar = 404 = rankings lost + backlinks waste. examples (udaharan) kharab: /index.php?cat=4&id=99 | sara: /birthday-cakes kharab: /our-services-page | sara: /seo-services kharab: /blog/how-to-do-keyword-research-for-your-new-website-in-2026 | sara: /keyword-research-guide checklist badha slugs: keyword + nana + lowercase + hyphens badlela slugs par 301 redirects chhe main pages par parameter urls na hova joie

notebook point: "title + description ma primary keyword + h1-h6 properly follow". aa on-page seo nu skeleton chhe - kharab hierarchy = google confuse. title tag primary keyword pehla (beginning ma) 50-60 characters (cutoff talva mate) har page unique title formula: primary keyword - faydo/modifier | brand meta description 150-160 aksharo primary keyword + faydo + cta unique per page, copy-paste nahi direct ranking factor nathi - pan saru description ctr (clicks) vadhare chhe, ane vadhu clicks = vadhu traffic heading hierarchy (h1-h6) ek j h1 per page - primary keyword sathe, page nu main topic h2 = mukhya sections (secondary keywords include karo) h3 = h2 na sub-sections of h2 levels kyarey skip na karo: h1 → h3 direct nahi, h1 → h2 → h3 styling mate headings use nahi: bold text joitu hoy to css, heading tag nahi udaharan structure h1: eggless cake delivery in surat h2: why choose our eggless cakes h3: 100% vegetarian ingredients h2: delivery areas in surat h2: faq checklist darek page par primary keyword sathe 1 h1 title 50-60 chars, pehla keyword, unique meta description 150-160 chars, cta sathe h1-h6 hierarchy clean, koi level skip nahi

notebook point 9: "primary - secondary - faq all keywords properly follow in all pages". har page ne clear keyword assignment hovi joiye - nahi to 2 pages same keyword mate fight kare (cannibalization) ane banna haray. darek page mate 3-tier structure primary keyword (1): page nu main target. aa aama aave: title, h1, slug, first paragraph, meta description. secondary keywords (3-5): sambandhit variations. aama aave: h2s, body content, image alt. faq keywords (3-5): question format ma. faq section ma sidha jawab sathe aave. mapping sheet banavo columns: page url | primary keyword | secondary keywords | faq keywords | search intent | status rule: 1 keyword = 1 page. same keyword 2 pages par = problem. keyword placement (density nahi) primary keyword title, h1, slug ane first paragraph ma aave - te enough chhe keyword density google no ranking factor nathi - % target set na karo stuffing (same word vaar-vaar, unnatural) avoid karo - synonyms ane related terms naturally vapro. example (cake site) primary: "eggless cake delivery surat" secondary: "eggless birthday cake", "same day cake delivery", "order cake online surat" faq: "eggless cake ketla divas fresh rahe?", "surat ma kaya area ma delivery chhe?" checklist keyword mapping sheet complete chhe koi 2 pages ma same primary keyword nahi natural keyword placement (stuffing nahi, % target nahi) faq sections ma faq keywords [added] mapping sheet nu standard format (badha sop mate ek j): 02 domain research → 07 keyword research gu

google helpful content system pachhi thin content rank j nahi thay. har page "koi pan ai 10 second ma lakhi shake" jevu hoy to replace thai jashe. depth + originality = survival. quality na markers search intent satisfy karo: user aa page par su expect kare te male - no clickbait mismatch puri coverage: topic nu full answer - user ne pachho google par javab shodhvu na pade potanu original value: unique data, own photos, real examples, personal experience - je copy na thay vanchi shakay evo format: nana paragraphs, subheadings, lists, tables, images update karelu: juna facts = trust gumay. dates + data regularly refresh karo thin content na signals (avoid karo) 300 words page je koi question fully answer na kare same content multiple pages par (duplicate) review/value-add vagar nu ai-generated text keyword stuffing je read karva ma awkward lage test har page mate pucho: "jo aa page internet par na hot, to koinu nuksan?" answer "na" hoy to page improve karo ke remove karo. checklist top 20 pages nu quality audit thayelu thin pages improve/merge/remove karela key pages par original elements (data/photos/experience)

url badlay, page delete thay, product band thay - dar vakhte saacho status code jaruri chhe. galat handling = backlinks waste, users frustrated, crawl budget waste. status codes simple bhasha ma 301: kayam mate move thayu - page ni value nava url ne pass thay. slug change, domain change, pages merge mate. 302: temporary move (sale page, a/b test). lambo time 302 rakhvu nahi. 404: page nathi. normal chhe - badha 404 problem nathi. 410: page kayam mate gayu - google 404 jevu j treat kare (farak bahu nano). soft 404: page "nathi" kahe pan status 200 aape, ke badha deleted pages homepage par redirect - google ene soft 404 gane. kevi rite check karvu screaming frog crawl → response codes → 3xx, 4xx filter. gsc → pages → not found (404) ane soft 404 lists. redirect chains: a → b → c hoy to a → c direct karo (max 1 hop). redirect loop: a → b → a - page khule j nahi, tarat fix. nirnay no niyam 404 page par backlinks ke traffic hoy → nearest relevant page par 301 koi value nathi ane replacement nathi → 404/410 rehva do internal broken link → link j update karo (redirect par aadhar na rakho) checklist monthly crawl: 0 internal broken links koi redirect chain ke loop nathi backlink vala 404 pages ne 301 aapela search ane popular links sathe custom 404 page

t: 1. Core Principles: Modern Search Framework (SEO + GEO + AEO + SXO)
x: traditional search optimization focused solely on keyword placement and backlinks to earn top positions in standard search engine results pages. modern search requires a unified strategy across four foundational pillars: pillar focus area execution strategy seo traditional search keyword targeting, technical architecture, and internal linking to rank in google blue links. aeo answer engines placing a concise 40–60 word summary at the top of content to capture featured snippets and voice answers. geo / aio generative ai optimizing for brand mentions and entity citations inside chatgpt, gemini, perplexity, and google ai overviews. sxo search experience improving core web vitals, mobile usability, fast load times, and conversion paths upon user arrival. e-e-a-t trust layer experience & expertise: content must feature verified author credentials, direct hands-on observations, and authentic domain knowledge. authoritativeness & trust: zero tolerance for fake stats or hallucinated data. every claim must be backed by accurate source citation or primary research.

keep discovery and optimization workflows strictly separated to prevent scope creep and keyword cannibalization. strategy 1: new topic discovery analyze niche: define exact target topics based on primary products, services, and core audience pain points. map existing assets: catalog all published blogs, urls, and landed keywords across the domain. build exclusion map: cross-reference prospective topics against existing urls to ensure no overlapping keyword intent. identify gaps: select unaddressed user questions and informational queries that map directly back to business services or catalog products. strategy 2: gsc low-click / high-impression optimization export gsc data: filter google search console performance data for the last 3 months. isolate striking distance queries: filter for queries occupying positions 5–20 with high impressions but low click-through rates (ctr). cluster & map: group related striking-distance queries around a single central topic. create supporting assets: write high-intent informational blogs targeting these query clusters. funnel page equity: link all new supporting articles directly back to primary commercial/money pages (never create competing commercial landing pages).

x: q: seo, aeo ane geo no difference su chhe? optimization type core objective primary target strategy focus seo (search engine optimization) rank in top organic search listings search engine results pages (serps) keywords, technical seo, backlinks, on-page aeo (answer engine optimization) capture position 0 & direct answers featured snippets, voice search (siri/alexa) concisely structured answers, faq schema geo (generative engine optimization) secure citation in ai responses gemini, chatgpt, perplexity, ai overviews first-party data, e-e-a-t, brand entity authority optimization workflow for geo & helpful content: bluf approach (bottom line up front): provide the direct core answer within the first two sentences. structured data: comprehensive implementation of faqpage and howto schemas. e-e-a-t signals: detailed author credentials, original primary research, case studies, and proprietary data points. originality verification: pass strict ai and plagiarism checks while injecting authentic human expertise and lived experience.

q: jo 20,000 pages koi site ma hoy ane ee index na thay to tamaro step-by-step approach su rahe? google search console deep-dive analysis: 'discovered currently not indexed': indicates crawl budget constraints, server response latency, or weak internal link hierarchy. 'crawled currently not indexed': points to perceived low content quality, thin content, or internal duplication. excluded by noindex / canonical mismatch: technical directive misconfigurations. technical crawlability checks: audit robots.txt for unintended disallow rules. analyze time to first byte (ttfb) and resolve intermittent 5xx server failures. xml sitemap segmentation: segment 20,000 pages into smaller sitemaps of 1,000–2,000 urls grouped by category or directory to isolate indexation drop-offs. internal link architecture: pass link equity from high-authority pages using contextual internal links, optimized breadcrumb paths, and static html sitemaps to resolve orphan pages. q: koi new website hoy to tame kai rite seo start karo ane ketlo time estimate thay? month 1: foundation & technical setup console setups (gsc, ga4), core technical site audit, domain structure planning, entity branding profiles creation. month 2: low-hanging fruit execution targeting long-tail keywords (kd < 25), structural core service page optimization, search intent mapping. month 3: topical authority & hub-and-spoke content deployment of e-e-a-t rich pillar pages, supporting clusters, schema integration, and internal link routing.

q: current company kem chodo cho / kem change karva mango cho? answer: "current company nu business model mostly in-house/personal projects par based chhe ane external client work diversify thai ne out-source thay chhe. aa lidhe mane direct client-facing exposure ane diverse industry challenges par strategy test karvano scope limited male chhe. mari learning curve faster rakhva ane broad client accounts handle karva hu navi opportunity sodhu chhu." q: 8 hours daily current company ma su kaam karta hata? 09:00 am – 10:00 am: health check & performance monitoring reviewing google search console, ga4 analytics, rank tracking tools, and diagnosing sudden indexation or technical anomalies. 10:00 am – 12:30 pm: on-page & content strategy execution keyword mapping, content gap analysis, writing/optimizing title tags, meta descriptions, heading structures, and schema implementations. 01:30 pm – 03:30 pm: technical seo & engineering coordination crawling sites via screaming frog, coordinating with developers on core web vitals optimization, fixing 404 errors, and setting up redirect matrices. 03:30 pm – 05:00 pm: off-page seo & competitive intelligence analyzing competitor backlink profiles, managing high-quality outreach campaigns, and auditing link quality metrics. 05:00 pm – 06:00 pm: reporting, analytics & search algorithm research compiling client/executive performance dashboards, measuring conversion goals, and staying up to date with the latest google algorithm updates.
